newsitem.title: USA: Dow Chemical says claim against it dismissed.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical says claim against it dismissed.

text.p: Dow Chemical Co. Tuesday said the Louisiana Civil District Court ruled that the company cannot be tried on the claim of strict product liability in a class action silicone breast implant lawsuit.
Instead, the court ruled on Monday that the devices were legally products of Dow Corning Corp., a 50-50 joint venture of Dow Chemical and Corning Inc., the company said.
It said the ruling meant that Dow Chemical was not, as a matter of law, a manufacturer of silicone breast implants.
Dow Chemical said the finding was consistent with those of other courts in the country that have tried such cases filed by women who allege that silicone breast implants are harmful.
Midland, Mich.-based Dow Chemical said three claims still stand against it -- fraudulent misrepresentation and concealment, civil conspiracy, and aiding and abetting.
Dow Chemical's stock rose 37.5 cents to $83.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.
